page.overview:
Who is Vayelle Kamsa?

Vayella is very weak in the One Power, with a strength level of . This is marginally above Siuan Sanche's strength after she was healed from Severing.

Vayelle is 86 years old and has been Aes Sedai for 44. She was born in 914 NE and went to the White Tower in . After spending thirteen years as a novice and eleven years as Accepted, she was raised to the shawl in 956 NE.

She was part of the White Tower secret expedition who were to kidnap Rand al'Thor in Cairhien.

She was captured by the Asha'man at the Battle of Dumai's Wells.
